records.substantiveReason: The coupled pi system is a band-specific chromophore. The 350/500 nm gaps are 3.54/2.48 eV, absorption arrows point upward, and the supplied protonation raises the relevant transition energy. The fresh sp3 bridge removes joint coupling without excluding local chromophores; 330 nm is UV. All three current expectations are assessed, without importing historical auxochrome names or colourant classification into this goal.

The actual task includes negligible reflectance outside 430–480 nm, so blue under white light and darkness under 590 nm follow from the supplied spectrum. The independent A/B comparison retains equal red but different green reflection, and 40% versus 5% explains brightness under 550 nm. No exact full colour coordinate is inferred from three bands.

Both sampled maxima stay at 500 nm while absorbance halves with concentration. The task distinguishes sampled from exact maximum and intensity from transition energy. All three additive X/Y readings match M, and 450/650 nm give model selectivity without unique identity from three samples.

The explicit historical HB convention is supplied and bounded: coupled amine donor/auxochrome and nitro acceptor/antiauxochrome can overlap a band-specific chromophore. Protonation reduces available lone-pair donation in this given comparison. The new sp3 bridge tests a different coupling condition rather than a universal group-colour rule. All three current expectations remain required.

Azo, triarylmethane and anthocyanin structure families plus the retained polyene card are assessed. Five separate criteria are not conflated. The identical synthetic C and P-to-P-prime changes distinguish origin, structure, solubility and use. Extraction is not new molecular synthesis; isolated C=C supports the broad polyene label without proving conjugation, colour, safety or LCA. The four original expectations and HB217 addition all remain assessed; no extra energy-calculation duty is imposed here.

HIn/In-minus are protonation states rather than resonance contributors. The pH 6/8 ratios are 0.1/10 and the transition is gradual. B-plus + H-plus + 2 electrons to neutral BH conserves charge; the supplied conjugation change explains decolouring and oxygen permits reverse oxidation. Redox colour is not a unique uncalibrated pH measurement.

Both aromatic attacks, carbonyl/OH protonation, water loss and each rearomatisation are explicitly demanded. Condensation and leuco oxidation conserve matter and charge; leuco to cation plus H-plus and two electrons has net zero. Fresh R changes the aldehyde residue and X retains OH with only two aryl groups. The specified oxidation step cannot supply the missing aryl C–C bond. The route is bounded and no unprovided alternative oxidation product is asserted; no actual synthesis credit is claimed.

The complete bounded route includes amino-N attack on nitrosating NO-plus, the supplied N–N intermediates, proton transfers/water loss to diazonium, and atom/charge balance. ArNH2 + HNO2 + H-plus to ArN2-plus + 2 water preserves 2 N/2 O/4 H and charge +1 outside Ar. Ring attack on terminal diazonium N, N-triple-N electron shift, positive sigma complex and rearomatisation are required for both changed partners. Donor protonation reduces activation. Grouped proton transfers are permitted by the current P; no hidden full proton-transfer network or actual execution is added.

Wool NH3-plus adds electrostatic attraction to anionic dye; both fibres can hydrogen bond without a new covalent bond. The separate reactive-cellulose model forms Cell–O–C with chloride departure, while polyester disperse-dye uptake remains intermolecular. Washing, photochemical and chemical limits prevent an unconditional fastness claim. Both current expectations and a changed fixation model are assessed.

Actual attributed BASF and museum cards replace a solely fictional historical example. Investment is distinguished from sales, profit and present currency. Company interests and the museum's different social/market scope are assessed, including missing full accounts and welfare data. The fresh 1901 source supports colourfastness/lightfastness and new applications, not permanent market control. The new task corrects inherited wash-fastness wording; original input material is not silently repaired or endorsed.

Both supplied BW cases connect history, present chemical design/analysis/application and a justified future test. Indigo redox/solubility is not a covalent cellulose bond and indigo is not an azo dye. U/V water/reductant savings conflict with energy and retention. Similar A/B absorption does not establish equal washing; predicted C degradability establishes neither performance nor harmless products. All four current expectations remain conjunctive, while actual synthesis or original research is not claimed.

records.substantiveReason: The generic paper header explicitly preserves actual own EFSA retrieval with URL, section and date. Both lookup criteria are noncompensable because passing equals the full score. Oral beverage evidence is separated from skin exposure, identity/impurities and release. Neither natural origin nor matching assumed colourfastness proves safety. The task offers a real research opportunity but supplies no learner lookup or universal approval.

Pressing/filtering separates existing triglycerides; transesterification produces FAME/glycerol and fermentation ethanol/CO2. The 30+70 kg seed balance does not establish oil recovery without seed oil content. A stated generation convention is used without universal classification or climate guarantees. Fresh wood/syngas differs from FAME and filtered rapeseed oil remains oil; GK receives no full FT-LK duty.

Gasification, cleanup/ratio conditioning, FT and mixture upgrading each have a distinct function. The ideal 8 CO + 17 H2 equation balances C/H/O; 20/44 gives 2.5 mol octane, 20 water and 1.5 H2 left. The fresh coal/20 CO/34 H2 case is CTL, with 2 octane, 16 water and 4 CO left. Ideal stoichiometry establishes no actual selectivity, pure fuel or carbon-neutral LCA.

Shortwave reflection is separated from longwave absorption/emission and downward emission. The net fluxes 0/+2 express initial storage, not energy creation or an exact temperature. Fossil input, CO2 stock, IR effect and climate response are separate causal steps. New reflection 33 gives net -1 while retaining the CO2 IR contribution; global balance, inertia and regional consequences remain distinct. Mitigation is assessed under explicit criteria, without attributing one weather event.

Both supplied reactions are balanced, while nonreactive formulation has no reaction atom economy. Recomputed 92.5%/81.08%, both water-boundary PMI/E pairs, 1.020408/0.020408 and 87.40% agree. Reaction water remains in the no-process-water waste boundary. Fresh solvent-volume reduction alone does not halve total PMI/E; water-only loss changes the functional-component fraction to 81.63%. Mass accounting does not establish equal washing service, toxicity, energy or sustainability.
